Renting heavy equipment involves multiple logistical factors. We have compiled a baseline of common financial and operational questions to help you prepare your project appropriately.

sg_accordion_list.sg_accordion_list_title: Are fuel costs included in the daily rate?
sg_accordion_list.sg_accordion_list_content: No, all equipment is delivered fully fueled and must be returned fully fueled. If returned with less than a full tank, a standard refueling surcharge will be applied based on current market rates.

sg_accordion_list.sg_accordion_list_title: Is insurance required to rent equipment?
sg_accordion_list.sg_accordion_list_content: Yes. You must provide a valid Certificate of Liability Insurance specifically covering rented heavy equipment. Alternatively, we offer a Physical Damage Waiver (PDW) for an additional 14% of the rental fee.

sg_accordion_list.sg_accordion_list_title: What happens if a machine breaks down on site?
sg_accordion_list.sg_accordion_list_content: All rentals include 24/7 mobile mechanic response. If the issue cannot be resolved on-site within 4 hours, we will dispatch an identical replacement unit at zero cost to your operation to ensure minimum downtime.
